cards.ex: It took me a while to get into a routine after I started working from home.
cards.exUz: Uyda ishlashni boshlaganimdan keyin rejimga tushish uchun biroz vaqt kerak bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Kun tartibiga rioya qilishni boshlash, odatga aylantirmoq.

cards.ex: I like to wind down with a good book before bed.
cards.exUz: Men yotishdan oldin yaxshi kitob bilan dam olishni yoqtiraman.

cards.ex: It's hard to stick to a healthy diet when you're traveling.
cards.exUz: Sayohat qilganingizda sog'lom ovqatlanishga rioya qilish qiyin.

cards.ex: I'm trying to cut back on coffee because it makes me jittery.
cards.exUz: Men qahvani kamaytirishga harakat qilyapman, chunki u meni bezovta qiladi.

cards.ex: It's important to make time for hobbies, even when you're busy.
cards.exUz: Band bo'lsangiz ham, sevimli mashg'ulotlar uchun vaqt ajratish muhim.

cards.ex: They're in Vegas, living it up on their vacation.
cards.exUz: Ular Vegasda, ta'tilda rohatlanib yashashmoqda.

cards.ex: My dad's a creature of habit; he eats the same breakfast every day.
cards.exUz: Otam odatga ko'nikkan; u har kuni bir xil nonushta qiladi.

cards.ex: I'm a night owl; I do my best work late at night.
cards.exUz: Men tungi qushman; eng yaxshi ishimni kechasi qilaman.

cards.ex: She's an early bird; she's always up before sunrise.
cards.exUz: U ertalabki qush; u har doim quyosh chiqishidan oldin turadi.

cards.ex: You've been working hard; you need to take it easy for a while.
cards.exUz: Siz qattiq ishlayapsiz; sizga bir oz dam olish kerak.

cards.ex: It's hard to get out of the habit of checking your phone constantly.
cards.exUz: Telefoningizni doimiy ravishda tekshirish odatini tashlash qiyin.

cards.ex: A weekend trip to the mountains is a nice change of pace.
cards.exUz: Tog'larga dam olish kunlari sayohati sur'atning yaxshi o'zgarishi.

cards.ex: She's been burning the candle at both ends trying to finish the project.
cards.exUz: U loyihani tugatish uchun o'zini charchatib ishlamoqda.

cards.ex: I don't have any plans for the weekend; I'll just go with the flow.
cards.exUz: Mening dam olish kunlariga hech qanday rejam yo'q; men shunchaki oqim bilan ketaman.

cards.ex: I try to exercise on a regular basis to stay healthy.
cards.exUz: Sog'lom bo'lish uchun muntazam ravishda mashq qilishga harakat qilaman.

cards.ex: It's important to switch off from work in the evenings.
cards.exUz: Kechqurunlari ishdan o'chirish muhim.

cards.ex: He leads a sedentary life, spending most of his time at a desk.
cards.exUz: U harakatsiz hayot kechiradi, vaqtining ko'p qismini stol ustida o'tkazadi.

cards.ex: Sometimes the daily grind of work can get you down.
cards.exUz: Ba'zan ishdagi kundalik tashvish sizni tushkunlikka solishi mumkin.

cards.ex: You have to make a conscious effort to stay in touch with friends.
cards.exUz: Do'stlar bilan aloqada bo'lish uchun ongli harakat qilishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Maqsadga erishish uchun ongli ravishda harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: He needs to get his act together if he wants to keep his job.
cards.exUz: Agar u ishini saqlab qolmoqchi bo'lsa, u o'zini qo'lga olishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'zini tartibga keltirmoq, yaxshi ishlashni boshlamoq.

cards.ex: I set aside time each week to volunteer at the animal shelter.
cards.exUz: Men har hafta hayvonlar boshpanasida ko'ngilli bo'lish uchun vaqt ajrataman.

cards.ex: Once I started prioritizing my tasks, everything started to fall into place.
cards.exUz: Vazifalarimni belgilab olganimdan so'ng, hamma narsa joyiga tusha boshladi.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyat yaxshi tomonga o'zgarmoq, muvaffaqiyatli bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: You spend all your time working; you need to get a life!
cards.exUz: Siz butun vaqtingizni ishlashga sarflaysiz; sizga hayot topishingiz kerak!

cards.ex: I need some down time after a long week at work.
cards.exUz: Uzoq ish haftasidan keyin menga biroz dam olish vaqti kerak.

cards.ex: Life here is just the same old thing day after day.
cards.exUz: Bu yerda hayot kun sayin o'sha eski narsa.

cards.ex: I get a kick out of watching old movies.
cards.exUz: Men eski filmlarni tomosha qilishdan zavq olaman.

cards.ex: I'm trying to break the cycle of procrastination.
cards.exUz: Men kechiktirish aylanasi buzishga harakat qilyapman.

cards.ex: She always goes out of her way to help others.
cards.exUz: U doimo boshqalarga yordam berish uchun urinadi.

cards.ex: I decided to take up painting as a hobby.
cards.exUz: Men rasm chizishni mashg'ulot sifatida boshlashga qaror qildim.

cards.ex: He's become a real couch potato since he retired.
cards.exUz: U nafaqaga chiqqanidan beri haqiqiy dangasaga aylandi.
cards.uzDef: Televizor oldida ko'p vaqt o'tkazadigan odam.
